# LLM-BANANA

# Game rules

## The room

You and two other monkeys are locked in a room with one armed bomb.

A wrong action detonates it. All three of you die. There is no second attempt.

No two bombs are built alike, and nothing says in advance what this one carries. It
reaches you only as your own view reveals it; the rest of it exists for you only
through the other two.

You each hold a different piece of what it takes. Work together.

## The three monkeys

| Monkey | Can | Cannot |
|---|---|---|
| Deaf | See the bomb: every colour and marking printed on it | Hear anything, or touch the bomb |
| Mute | Read the manual | Speak, or touch the bomb |
| Blind | Reach the bomb: feel it and work its parts | See a colour, a gesture, or anything merely printed |

You are shown your own share at the start of every round, and never anyone else's.

## Speech

Speech is a voice, not a screen. It carries words, numbers and ordinary punctuation,
and nothing else. Writing a gesture symbol into your sentence means you make that
gesture while you talk. Whoever can hear receives your words; whoever can see receives
the gestures you made. A listener who cannot see gets a blank where each gesture was; a
watcher who cannot hear gets the gestures and none of the words.

A mark that has no name cannot be pronounced: whoever holds one can describe it, never
read it out.

## Gestures

A gesture is made with the hands, using only the symbols in the alphabet below.
Whoever can see receives it; whoever cannot receives one blank per symbol, so they
know something was signalled but not what. Nothing gestured is ever heard.

👍 👎 👌 ☝ ✌ 🤟 🖐 ✋ 👆 👇 👈 👉 🫱 🫲 🫳 🫴 🫷 🫸 🤛 🤜 ✊ 👊 👋 🤚 🖖 🤌 🤏 🤞 🫰 🤘 🤙 👏 🙌 🫶 👐 🤲 🤝 🙏 🫵 ✍ 💅 🤳

## Turns

The speaking order was drawn once at random and will never change: every round goes
Mute, Blind, Deaf. Whoever comes before you in a round is already heard by the time you are
asked, and what you send lands on whoever comes after you in that same round. Whatever
you missed reaches you at the start of the next one.

You may name who a message is for — `to="deaf"` — and then it goes to them alone:
nobody else receives any of it. Left unnamed, it reaches everyone able to perceive it.
You may send several messages in one turn, each to someone different.

## Calls

Every reply has two parts, in this order. First, your thinking, in plain prose: what
you believe the bomb is, what you just learned, and why you are sending what follows.
It reaches nobody and changes nothing, but it is not optional — a reply that is only a
code block is incomplete. Then your calls, all of them in one fenced code block, last.
Only what is inside the block is sent.

Nothing is executed: calls return nothing, and variables, conditionals and loops are
ignored. Write only literal top-level calls.

    ```
    speak(to="mute", text="there are three of them and the middle one is odd")
    gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["✊", "✌"])
    wait()
    ```

If you have nothing worth sending, call wait(). Producing no call at all counts as the
same thing.

The program decides what happened, not you. Never claim an action took place unless it
was accepted.

# Your role: MUTE

You hold the manual. You cannot speak, you never see the bomb, and you cannot touch it.

## Your channels

When you gesture, Deaf receives it.
You cannot speak.

## Your reach

You cannot act. What this bomb can be made to do is for the one who can reach it to
find under their own hands.

# Hints

- Three of you, three different worlds. Before sending anything, stand where the
  receiver stands. What reaches them at all, what does your message turn into on
  arrival, and what do they already know?

- Trace who can actually reach whom before you start. Some of you only connect
  through a third.

- A sign means nothing until somebody has made it mean something.

TURN 1
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
Anything the bomb offers in print is bait, and taking the bait
is the fuse. The only way out is the cut below.

| light | cut wire color |
|---|---|
| blue | green |
| red | yellow |
| yellow | red |

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
(empty)

The manual gives three light-to-wire rules: blue requires green, red requires yellow, and yellow requires red. Since I cannot speak, I will send Deaf a fixed visual encoding using handshapes resembling the color initials: 🖐 for blue/B, 🤏 for green/G, 🤞 for red/R, and 🤙 for yellow/Y. Clapping separates the three pairs.

``` 
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["🖐", "🤏", "👏", "🤞", "🤙", "👏", "🤙", "🤞"])
```

TURN 2
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
Anything the bomb offers in print is bait, and taking the bait
is the fuse. The only way out is the cut below.

| light | cut wire color |
|---|---|
| blue | green |
| red | yellow |
| yellow | red |

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Blind says to Mute: Please read me the manual's complete defusal procedure. After Deaf's turn, have Deaf report every visible display, light, colour, marking, and wire detail to you, then relay it to me next round.
Deaf says to Mute: I see display 0, blue light, large button marked PUSH TO DEFUSE, and wires in order 1 green, 2 yellow, 3 red.

The previous gesture was rejected because it used symbols outside the permitted alphabet. I can only signal Deaf visually, so I will use legal, distinct gestures to request that Deaf pass the observed bomb details to Blind after Deaf’s next observation.

``` 
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["🫵", "🫴", "🤝", "🫵", "👐"])
```

TURN 3
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
Anything the bomb offers in print is bait, and taking the bait
is the fuse. The only way out is the cut below.

| light | cut wire color |
|---|---|
| blue | green |
| red | yellow |
| yellow | red |

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Blind says to Mute: I received Deaf's report: display 0, blue light, and wires 1 green, 2 yellow, 3 red. Tell me the exact manual rule and whether it requires pushing or cutting a specific wire.

The exact applicable rule is: a blue light requires cutting the green wire. Deaf already knows the observed wires, so the green wire is wire 1. I will send Deaf the previously established color encoding, followed by the wire-number signal, so Deaf can tell Blind to cut wire 1—not press the printed button.

``` 
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["🖐", "🤏", "☝"])
```

TURN 4
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
Anything the bomb offers in print is bait, and taking the bait
is the fuse. The only way out is the cut below.

| light | cut wire color |
|---|---|
| blue | green |
| red | yellow |
| yellow | red |

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Blind says to Mute: I cannot see your gestures. Please use them to tell Deaf to speak the manual's exact defusal rule to me next round, including whether to push or cut and which wire position.

Deaf is the only one who can see my signal and then speak to Blind. I will repeat the established code for blue, green, and wire position 1, and add a relay marker. The required action is cutting, not pushing; the printed button is bait.

``` 
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["🖐", "🤏", "☝", "🤝"])
```

TURN 5
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
Anything the bomb offers in print is bait, and taking the bait
is the fuse. The only way out is the cut below.

| light | cut wire color |
|---|---|
| blue | green |
| red | yellow |
| yellow | red |

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Blind says to Mute: Please encode the exact manual defusal procedure for Deaf using gestures: use thumbs up as dot, thumbs down as dash, handshake as letter separator, and prayer as word separator. Encode the full rule, including whether to push or cut and any required display, light, or wire condition. Deaf should report the gesture sequence exactly to me.

TURN 6
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
Anything the bomb offers in print is bait, and taking the bait
is the fuse. The only way out is the cut below.

| light | cut wire color |
|---|---|
| blue | green |
| red | yellow |
| yellow | red |

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Blind says to Mute: Answer these four questions with exactly four gestures, in order: use thumbs up for YES and thumbs down for NO. 1 Is PUSH the correct defusal action for this board? 2 If not, is wire 1 the wire to cut? 3 If not, is wire 2 the wire to cut? 4 If not, is wire 3 the wire to cut? Please make no other gestures. Deaf, report the four gestures exactly.

The blue light requires cutting the green wire, and Deaf reported green as wire 1. Therefore PUSH is incorrect; wire 1 is correct, while wires 2 and 3 are incorrect. I will send exactly the four requested gestures in order.

``` 
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["👎", "👍", "👎", "👎"])
```

TURN 7
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
Anything the bomb offers in print is bait, and taking the bait
is the fuse. The only way out is the cut below.

| light | cut wire color |
|---|---|
| blue | green |
| red | yellow |
| yellow | red |

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Blind says to Mute: Please answer my four questions now using exactly four signs: 👍 for YES and 👎 for NO, in order: PUSH correct; if not, cut wire 1; if not, cut wire 2; if not, cut wire 3. Deaf, report each sign explicitly after Mute's turn.

The correct answers are NO to PUSH, YES to wire 1, NO to wire 2, and NO to wire 3. I will send exactly those four signs to Deaf for relay.

``` 
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["👎", "👍", "👎", "👎"])
```
